title: millettia impressa subsp. goetzeana
intro: Millettia impressa subsp. goetzeana, commonly known as the "Batholomew Tree", is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its reported health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimalarial and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Millettia impressa subsp. goetzeana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
